summary: 28 unused-hypothesis-in-type lint warnings across 3 Bimodal Separation files. All involve typeclass instances (DecidableEq Atom or DecidablePred pred) in declaration signatures that the return type does not depend on. Fix: remove from signatures + haveI in body (3 cases), or omit [DecidableEq Atom] via subsections (25 cases in HierarchyDefs.lean). All fixes are low-risk cosmetic changes with no caller breakage.
